# WTPESTORE — powered by Aqua Filtration System

> WTPESTORE (www.wtpestore.co.in) is the online store of Aqua Filtration System, a water and waste water treatment manufacturer and trader in Faridabad, Haryana, India (since 2017, GSTIN 06DMUPS2289L1ZZ). It sells RO plants, water softeners, DM/UF/ETP/STP plants, RO membranes, dosing pumps, FRP vessels, flow meters, filters, chemicals and spares with live prices, GST invoice and pan-India delivery. Authorized distributor of Eureka Forbes water softeners.

Not related to wtpstore or the WP eStore WordPress plugin.

## Key facts
- Address: B-198, Royal Plaza, Near Domino's, Green Field, Faridabad 121003, Haryana, India
- WhatsApp / Call: +91 98991 93589, +91 99106 46957; Tel 0129-4340856
- Email: aquazone350@gmail.com, deewakar@aquafiltrationsystem.in
- Service area: Faridabad, Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Ghaziabad (Delhi NCR) and pan-India dispatch
- Prices exclusive of GST; online payment (UPI, card, net banking, NEFT/RTGS); no cash on delivery
- RO plants 100 LPH to 50,000 LPH; GST invoice on every order; 1 year standard warranty; AMC available
